title: billing / giftcard.redeemed (v1) data payload
description: Billing (stored-value ledger SoT) REDEEMED a bearer gift card — either loaded into a wallet or spent directly at the POS (Round 17, ADR-0011). Published to 'billing.events' with routing key 'giftcard.redeemed'. Redemption is idempotent (inbox + ledger guard): a code cannot be double-spent. Consumed by Frontend, Bar/POS (local balance copy), Control Room. Partial redemption supported via 'balanceAfter'.

giftCardId.description: The gift card redeemed (stable ledger id).

mode.description: loaded_to_wallet = balance moved into a wallet; spent = redeemed directly against a POS charge.

amount.description: Amount redeemed in this action, currency MINOR units (integer cents).

balanceAfter.description: Authoritative remaining balance on the gift card after this redemption (ECST).

masterId.description: Target/redeeming masterId when mode=loaded_to_wallet (the wallet) or an identified driver spending at POS; null for an anonymous POS spend.

at.description: When the redemption was applied (RFC3339 UTC).
